_source: docs/specs/00-BUILD-CONTEXT.md promise list P-1..P-19; priority from decision #40 (prio-1 = M5 ... prio-11 = M1/M9).

ac: Given a synthetic category set, the router returns the Table 2.3 route (self_disclosure | scrutiny | scrutiny_evc | scrutiny_only) and the Annexure-2 document checklist
Every route decision cites the Table 2.3 row and APH edition
State rule tables (e.g. AP DTE list) are data files, not code [VERIFY other states]
No committee view is offered for a route without a committee

issues.claim: Template-aware extraction, year-versioned templates, content-based classifier
ac: Template version is chosen from the document itself (APPROVAL PROCESS YYYY-YY line + heading word), never from filename or uploader label
Anchor extraction reads known fields at known positions for the 2024-27 affidavit template on synthetic documents
declared_type ≠ classified_type raises suspected_anomaly.document_misclassified
Every extracted field carries confidence; template_id recorded on every document

issues.claim: Affidavit 2 normalised 24-declaration diff + Application Report reconciliation
ac: Normalised clause diff (whitespace, strike-through, names substituted) against the portal draft for the same AID and AY
Structure check: category line present; 19 core + 5 existing-institute declarations; extra blocks reported
Land and 4 room tables reconciled cell by cell against ApplicationSnapshot; room IDs unique across tables; computed total acres
Every flag cites rule_id, rule_version, APH clause and edition, with page regions

issues.claim: Real DSC vs image; CCA chain (test anchor); signer check; edited-after-signing; stamp chronology; notary-seal expiry
ac: Two independent checks per document (issuer, uploader); a printed mark without /ByteRange is IMAGE ONLY and never verified
Demo chain builds to a SATYA test root shown as TEST TRUST ANCHOR
Digest mismatch / modified after signing / revoked → mismatch_detected; untrusted chain or signer mismatch → manual_review_required
Chronology application ≤ stamp ≤ notarisation ≤ DSC ≤ upload checked; notary expiry ≥ notarisation date
pyHanko modification-analysis API confirmed during build [VERIFY V-8]

issues.claim: Source verification with the 6 PS labels (CCA offline; SHCIL, TN Form D, TN fire QR as mocks)
ac: Every check returns source, mode, checked_at, response_sha256, attempts
Mock adapters run in mode=mock and every result is labelled MOCK SOURCE in UI and reports
source_unavailable creates a manual-verification task (RB-09)
A valid uploader DSC never makes a document verified; TN fire QR gives only qr_consistency

issues.claim: Annexure-14 issuer + height/area checks on OC, Form D, fire licences
ac: Issuer type classified (planning authority / local body / e-District / revenue / engineer); revenue → manual review
Addressee entity, blocks covered and occupancy class checked against the snapshot
NMSB vs stated height (< 15 m) and licence built-up area vs building data
TN fire rules versioned by Act (1985 Act vs 2025 Act, commencement [VERIFY])

issues.claim: APH date rules incl. compliance window
ac: Rules are versioned YAML with rule_id, rule_version, aph_clause, aph_edition
Partial OC limited to 2 consecutive years; structural certificate required after 30 years; lease vs longest course
Compliance window parsed from the letter, else template-year table (2020-21 → 2 years, 2024-25 → 6 months), else window unknown → manual review; no invented deadline
Never recomputes Deficiency Report arithmetic (D2)
Each change across two synthetic years is marked explained (an approved application accounts for it) or discrepancy
Every discrepancy links both years' documents and the APH clause
Repeated self-disclosure deficiency after its compliance window is flagged
Stays advisory

issues.claim: Pseudonymised identity graph; Faculty ID update lag (6.14c)
ac: Faculty linked only by keyed tokens; no names, PAN or DOB stored
Faculty ID added/removed outside the same month is flagged with both dates
Portal's own is_duplicate and PAN validation shown tagged PORTAL, never recomputed (D2)
Reveal of a token requires a reason and is logged (AU-04)
Every flag shows evidence region, rule, APH clause, confidence and a text status label
Five dispositions (accept, override, escalate_clarify, escalate_refer, escalate_manual) with a reason ≥ 10 characters, written to the ledger
Anomaly flags carry 'Preliminary indicator. Needs human verification.'
No approve/reject/auto-clear control anywhere; undo is a new ledger entry
Every inbound event and every SATYA output appended to the chain (slice 0 already does inbound)
Chain integrity view (AU-02) recomputes and shows the first broken link
Case replay re-runs with the same inputs and returns the same run_id
Personal-data reveal entries visible in the access log
Alerts use the shared type + subtype enum and open the exact flag
Institution-facing alerts limited to missing_info, expired, unresolved.clarification_* and unresolved.compliance_window_*
Queue grouped by risk band with top 3 reasons and label counts; every status as text
D/M/S and decimal coordinates normalised; point inside the declared district
Land in at most 3 plots no more than 2 km apart
Coordinate moves across years beyond a threshold flagged (with M13)
Satellite imagery comparison is Phase 2
Phase 1: High/Medium/Low band with contributing flags and 'The band orders review only.'; never a 0–100 score; never shown to the institution; pre-check results never used
Phase 2: risk-ranked selection with a seeded random share, seed recorded in M12
AICTE decides the selection [VERIFY V-4]
Video duration ≥ 30 minutes
GPS overlay visible at the main, academic and administrative buildings and the library
Entry and exit times and approved building plan shown
Findings advisory to EVC experts
Format 2 classified by issuer (Registrar vs trust officers), not by heading
Multiple copies of one resolution compared
Certificate 2 room table reconciled with the affidavit room tables

issues.claim: Mock portal + proposed webhooks + SSO hand-off; private pre-check
ac: Mock portal titled 'Approval Portal (Mock, for demo)' with the demo banner and no AICTE branding (slice 0 done)
Fires every Phase 1 inbound event signed per §2.2 (slice 0: precheck_requested)
'Open in SATYA' deep link carries only the opaque case_id (§8.3)
Pre-check results private to the institution (#19); only the fact that a pre-check ran is logged
UDIN is 18 characters: YY + 6-digit membership no. + 6 letters + 4 digits
Chars 3–8 equal the membership number printed beside it; UDIN YY ≥ FY end
One UDIN per FY, not reused across years (with M13)
ICAI verification access [VERIFY]; without it the label is source_unavailable

issues.claim: M2 secure vault + redaction/tokenisation on ingest
specs: 04-portal §2.1 (documents pulled, SHA-256 checked), §2.2 data minimisation, §2.6.1 x-handling
ac: Documents fetched by reference, SHA-256 and size checked; mismatch → ingest.failed DOC_HASH_MISMATCH
Fields marked T tokenised (keyed HMAC-SHA256, key never stored with the data) before anything is stored; X fields rejected (slice 0 rejects X already)
Documents encrypted at rest; personal data redacted on ingest
Identifiers in vault documents masked by default with a logged reveal
